hypothesis: Publishing JOINT_DEFAULT after recorder subscription-ready should activate telemetry; after the first complete snapshot, four additional JOINT seconds should form a reset-compatible prefix before RL_DEFAULT.
intervention: One isolated domain219 attempt with subscription-ready and complete-snapshot-ready separated; no model, PD, reference, or threshold change.
control: Phase19 proved that zero/default mode produced 0/31 state and no odom/IMU for 15 seconds.

read_only_docker_observation.action_taken: none; foreign agent container was not stopped or modified

decision.result: Recorder subscription-ready and JOINT controller acknowledgement occurred, but the new official simulator aborted because TCP port 51822 was already occupied; no telemetry or replay-qualified artifact could be produced.
decision.conclusion: The activation-prefix protocol remains untested. This is a shared-resource collision with another running experiment, not a control, dynamics, reference, or Any2Any result.
decision.next_step: Stop without killing the other agent container or retrying. A separately authorized run must first prove port 51822 is free, then execute the same unchanged protocol.
